checks.applicability: Applies to pages on which the library is detected: its window global (with its version field) or, for jQuery, Bootstrap, AngularJS, Lodash and Handlebars, a script URL whose path names the library and a version.
checks.expectation: Fails for every detected AngularJS (1.x) version: the line is end of life and every release, including the last one 1.8.3, is covered by an advisory. There is no conforming version; the negative is a look-alike: Angular 2+ (@angular/core) is a different framework and not AngularJS. Detected through `angular.version.full` or a script path naming angular.js (not angular/). A page without the library: not applicable. A page that breaks the detection scripts (result missing or malformed) is not run for every library, never clean.
